title: Delta investigating after someone set up fake Wi-Fi network mid-flight | TechCrunch
summary: Once the crew became aware of the fake Wi-Fi network, the pilots sent two messages mid-flight to air traffic control. The pilots said a passenger “created a scam Wi-Fi” that was designed to impersonate the airplane’s legitimate wireless network.
